headlines: 53 disruptions a day during focus, 76 minutes a day in the apps that caused them. Longest uninterrupted stretch: 15 minutes on a typical day with focus, 15 minutes at best.
A disruption of 30 seconds costs 1 minute before the app that was left is back in front (medians over 45 disruptions). That adds up to 61 minutes a day.
No travel, shopping, video, social or news browsing during focus on 1 day with focus.
47 app switches per active hour. 30% of screen time is spent in stays shorter than 2 minutes (median stay 23 seconds).
Screen time 11h 57 a day over 1 day (Mac 5h 03, iPhone 6h 54). Most of it: communication 3h 58, social 3h 19, work 2h 28 a day.
AI tools open for 12h 05 a day by the clock, 24 sessions a day (24 sessions, 19h 15 of session time in total). 32% of session time was the tool waiting for the user.

phone_cadence.reason: not enough data: needs at least 3 days of phone usage, found 1
phone_cadence.minimum: at least 3 days of iPhone usage and 20 waking gaps between sessions; an hour needs 5 gaps, the working window 20

mac_app_cadence.reason: not enough data: needs at least 3 days of Mac usage, found 1
mac_app_cadence.minimum: at least 3 days of Mac usage; an app needs 10 activations on 2 or more days, and 5 gaps for a median gap

focus_disruptions.minimum: at least one focus stretch (15 minutes or more, at least half of it in work apps) or one planned goal block with device data
focus_disruptions.summary: 53 disruptions a day during focus, 76 minutes a day in the apps that caused them. Longest uninterrupted stretch: 15 minutes on a typical day with focus, 15 minutes at best.

recovery_cost.minimum: at least 5 disruptions after which the user got back to the app they left; a day needs 3 for its own median
recovery_cost.summary: A disruption of 30 seconds costs 1 minute before the app that was left is back in front (medians over 45 disruptions). That adds up to 61 minutes a day.

repeat_offenders.reason: not enough data: no app or site disrupted focus on 2 or more days (53 disruptions found)
repeat_offenders.minimum: an app or site that caused disruptions on at least 2 different days

drift.minimum: browsing data (web visits) and at least one focus stretch or planned work block
drift.summary: No travel, shopping, video, social or news browsing during focus on 1 day with focus.

late_screens.reason: not enough data: needs at least 3 nights with device data, found 0
late_screens.minimum: at least 3 nights inside the range on days with device data; usual bedtime needs 3 recorded sleeps of 3 hours or more; the recovery comparison needs 3 late and 3 other nights

context_switching.minimum: at least 60 minutes of active device time in the range; a day needs 30 active minutes for its own rate
context_switching.summary: 47 app switches per active hour. 30% of screen time is spent in stays shorter than 2 minutes (median stay 23 seconds).

time_by_app.minimum: any Mac or iPhone app usage in the range
time_by_app.summary: Screen time 11h 57 a day over 1 day (Mac 5h 03, iPhone 6h 54). Most of it: communication 3h 58, social 3h 19, work 2h 28 a day.

ai_tool_use.minimum: at least one AI session in the range; the waiting share needs sessions that report waiting time
ai_tool_use.summary: AI tools open for 12h 05 a day by the clock, 24 sessions a day (24 sessions, 19h 15 of session time in total). 32% of session time was the tool waiting for the user.
